sql: WITH modes(mode) AS (SELECT 'dw_only' UNION ALL SELECT 'purchase_negative'), nets AS (SELECT mode,customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions CROSS JOIN modes WHERE mode='purchase_negative' OR txn_type IN('deposit','withdrawal') GROUP BY mode,customer_id,m), balances AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY m) closing FROM nets), pairs AS (SELECT a.mode,a.m current_m,b.m prior_m,a.customer_id,a.closing current,b.closing prev FROM balances a JOIN balances b ON a.mode=b.mode AND a.customer_id=b.customer_id AND a.m>b.m) SELECT mode,current_m,prior_m,COUNT(*) pair_n,SUM(CASE WHEN prev=0 THEN current*100.0 ELSE (current-prev)*100.0/prev END>5) signed_n,SUM(CASE WHEN prev=0 THEN current*100.0 ELSE (current-prev)*100.0/ABS(prev) END>5) abs_n FROM pairs GROUP BY mode,current_m,prior_m ORDER BY mode,current_m,prior_m
